svg.text: internal junctions are named for what they join
U<ref>_<PIN> node at that IC pin e.g. UIVOA_VINP
identity per docs/magnetics.md (turns, gap, litz, acceptance lines live there)
D3 T1-T3: 2x E70/33/32 sets (B66372B2000 former), 7:7:7 (E65 rev C; E8 turns), Bpk 142mT @525V-bank sim, pri litz 2475x0.071 + sec Cu foil 0.10x28, Lm 63uH +/-7% gap-ground, BONDED
D2 L1T-L3T: 1x E70/33/32, N=8, bins 6.35/6.5/6.65/6.8uH, litz 6112x0.05, distributed gap, bonded (E65: carries ~all of Lr)
total Lr = D2 bin + measured xfmr leakage (~0.2uH) + 0.1uH loop; Cr at TANK sections
T_XFMR NTC loop runs through 6 NC 130C cutouts, one per D3/D2 (open loop = OT trip, E65 bond-loss cover)
DC-Modules 30 kW - board DC-DC (upper), sheet 2 of 3
